products.title: ETHIOPIA NATURAL DJIMMAH GR.5 - Green Coffee Beans
products.body_html:
Ethiopia Natural Djimmah Green Coffee Beans are known for their clean cup and smooth body, offering gentle hints of berry fruit, lemon citrus, and cinnamon with a bright acidity. These beans are sourced from the Oromia region, grown by smallholder farmers and processed with care to ensure their unique flavour profile is preserved.

Ethiopia Natural Djimmah Origin and Details

  • Country: Ethiopia
  • Region: Djimmah
  • Altitude: 1,650 - 2,000 meters above sea level
  • Variety: Heirloom Ethiopian Varieties, Grade 5
  • Processing Method: Natural, Sun-dried

Processing Method and Quality Control

The Oromia Coffee Farmers Cooperative Union (OCFCU) supports smallholder farmers by providing facilities for processing their coffee cherries. The beans are sun-dried using the natural processing method, which accentuates the coffee's fruity characteristics. Rigorous quality control ensures that each batch maintains a clean, smooth profile with consistent flavour notes.

Potential Flavour Notes and Characteristics

These green beans develop a flavour profile with hints of berry fruit, lemon citrus, and cinnamon, balanced by a hay and berry fruit aroma. The smooth body and bright acidity provide a refined, versatile coffee experience that can be explored through different roast levels.

products.title: BRAZIL FINCA CACHOEIRA NATURAL - Green Coffee Beans
products.body_html:
Brazil Finca Cachoeira Natural Green Coffee Beans are speciality grade unroasted Arabica coffee beans from the Cerrado region of Minas Gerais, Brazil. This coffee is known for its smooth, sweet and approachable profile, with potential flavour notes of milk chocolate, hazelnut and caramel after roasting.

Grown at around 1,100 metres above sea level on Finca Cachoeira, this coffee is produced by the Barbosa family, who are known for their focus on quality, consistency and sustainable farming practices. With an SCA score of 83, these speciality green coffee beans are a great choice for home roasters looking for a reliable Brazilian coffee with classic chocolate and nutty characteristics.

Brazil Finca Cachoeira Origin Details

  • Country: Brazil
  • Region: Cerrado, Minas Gerais
  • Farm: Finca Cachoeira
  • Producer: Barbosa family
  • Altitude: 1,100 metres above sea level
  • Variety: Red Catuai
  • Processing Method: Natural
  • SCA Score: 83

Processing Method

This coffee is naturally processed, meaning the coffee cherries are dried with the fruit still attached to the bean. This method helps increase sweetness, body and depth, making Brazil Finca Cachoeira a strong option for roasters who enjoy chocolate-led, nutty and caramel-like flavour profile

products.title: PERU CHANCHAMAYO - Green Coffee Beans
products.body_html:
Peru Chanchamayo Green Coffee Beans are known for their bright acidity and smooth body, offering a balanced cup with notes of caramel, cedar, and cinnamon. Grown in the Chanchamayo Valley of Peru, these beans are perfect for home roasters looking for a versatile coffee that captures the essence of South American coffee-growing traditions.

Peru Chanchamayo Origin and Details

  • Country: Peru
  • Region: Chanchamayo Valley
  • Altitude: 1,200 - 1,350 meters above sea level
  • Variety: Caturra, Typica, Pache, Bourbon
  • Processing Method: Washed, sun-dried
  • Harvest Period: June - August/September

Processing Method and Quality Control

Peru Chanchamayo beans are hand-picked and carefully processed using the washed method, followed by sun-drying to preserve the natural flavours. The combination of high-altitude growing conditions and sustainable farming practices results in a high-quality bean that is dense and flavourful, perfect for a range of roasting styles.

Potential Flavour Notes and Characteristics

When roasted, these beans develop a balanced flavour profile with notes of caramel, cedar, and cinnamon, coupled with a smooth body and bright acidity. The result is a well-rounded cup that is versatile enough for both light and dark roasts.
